notes.jiti@2.6.1→2.7.0: Checked by hand in both published tarballs: 2.7.0 bundles std-env 4, whose table of AI coding agents (claude: CLAUDECODE, CLAUDE_CODE; gemini: GEMINI_CLI; codex; cursor; replit; opencode…) is read at import. 2.6.1 has none of it.
notes.body-parser@2.2.2→2.3.0: Reads DEBUG, NO_DEPRECATION and TRACE_DEPRECATION at import; 2.2.2 did not. Both releases depend on debug; which import moved has not been traced.
notes.ci-info@4.3.1→4.4.0: Reads one more environment variable, ALPIC_HOST — ci-info detects CI vendors by their variables, and its list grew.
notes.std-env@4.1.0→4.2.0: Checked in both tarballs: the table of AI coding agents gained an entry, ["junie", ["JUNIE_DATA", "JUNIE_SHIM_PATH"]] — JetBrains’ agent. This is the library jiti 2.7.0 bundles.
notes.find-versions@5.1.0→6.0.0: Checked in the published code: 6.0.0 depends on super-regex, whose function-timeout runs new vm.Script('returnValue = functionToRun()') to put a time limit on a regular expression — the exact code the probe recorded. Code built at runtime, which the rules must flag and a person should read; this one is benign.
notes.babel-plugin-react-compiler@0.0.0→1.0.0: Checked in the published code: 0.0.0 is a placeholder; 1.0.0 bundles zod 4, which compiles its schema checks into functions at runtime (its allowsEval switch, and the "const input = payload.value" template the probe recorded). Benign.
notes.ssh-remote-port-forward@1.0.3→1.0.4: Checked: 1.0.4 moved from ssh2 0.8 to ssh2 1.x, and every new install command is ssh2's optional native build — its install.js, then cpu-features' "node buildcheck.js > buildcheck.gypi && node-gyp rebuild" with the compiler and Python probes that go with it. The runtime decode is ssh2 1.x's own. A new shell at install is exactly what should be flagged; this one is explained.
notes.bin-version@6.0.0→7.0.0: Checked: 7.0.0 depends on find-versions 6, whose super-regex → function-timeout runs regular expressions under vm.Script with a time limit — the code the probe recorded. Benign.
notes.bin-version-check@5.1.0→6.0.0: Checked: 6.0.0 depends on binary-version 7, which reaches find-versions 6 and the same function-timeout vm.Script. Benign.
notes.blob@0.0.5→0.1.0: Checked: 0.1.0 depends on esm, a module loader that compiles code through vm. Benign.
notes.eval@0.1.7→0.1.8: A package whose whole purpose is to evaluate code in a vm. Benign by design; flagged because it is exactly what the rule is for.
notes.edgedriver@6.3.1→7.0.0: The install command changed only in its fallback message ("project not build!" → "built!"). The rules treat any changed shell command as a new one, which is the right direction to err; Nemotron read it as the typo it is.
notes.vite-plugin-singlefile@2.3.2→2.3.3: Reads INPUT_AZURE_STATIC_WEB_APPS_API_TOKEN among 76 variables, the shape of a CI-vendor detection list. Its own code, in either version, does not mention it, so it comes with something installed alongside; not traced further, and not called benign.
